Package workerapp.model.builders

Class AbstractConsoleBuilder<T>

java.lang.Object
workerapp.model.builders.AbstractConsoleBuilder<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
CoordinatesBuilder, OrganizationBuilder, WorkerMainBuilder
public abstract class AbstractConsoleBuilder<T> extends Object
AbstractConsoleBuilder is an abstract class that provides common methods for building objects through console input. It uses an InputProvider to get the current Scanner and a Console to interact with the user. Subclasses of AbstractConsoleBuilder will implement the build() method to create specific objects based on user input.
